purpose: Teach: 管内/称号/単調/対称/要綱/パイオニア/訳注/経団連

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、管内の市場を歩いて回られた
lines.en: When we were starting out, Dad walked the markets in our region himself.
lines.style: Warm recollection, almost musing. Gentle voice, as if seeing the memory again. Slight pause before 'Dad' — that affectionate formality of respect. Measured, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業者称号より社員と呼ばれる事を好まれた
lines.en: Yes. He preferred being called a staff member rather than taking the title of founder.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact tone with underlying pride. No flourish — this is fact, stated as evidence of character. Quiet conviction. Eyes slightly distant, honoring the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、単調な作業も自ら手伝われた
lines.en: He helped with the routine work himself, too. He didn't ask anyone to do what he wouldn't do.
lines.style: Voice softens further. Almost tender. Slight smile in the delivery — a small, admiring shake of the head at the memory. Slow pace. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営に対称的なバランスを取られた
lines.en: That's right. He found balance in how he managed — never losing sight of the people.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Not lecturing, but reflecting aloud. Tone suggests he's clarifying something important about his father's philosophy. Deliberate, clear enunciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内要綱をご自分で書かれた
lines.en: And he wrote the company guidelines himself. His own hand, his own words.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet wonder at the dedication. Slight emphasis on 'himself' — not the detail of authorship, but the commitment it represents. Gentle, almost reverent pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが業界のパイオニアと呼ばれた
lines.en: Yes. That's how he became known as a pioneer in the industry — through his work, not his title.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. A conclusion drawn from evidence. Tone suggests this is the natural result of living as he did. Clear, steady voice. Slight weight of pride underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内出版物に訳注を添えられた
lines.en: He even added his own notes and commentary to the company publications. Everything bore his attention.
lines.style: Voice fills with genuine appreciation. Slight awe — not at the gesture alone, but at the consistency of his care. Warm, almost intimate tone. Gentle fadeout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経団連でも信頼されていた
lines.en: Even the Keidanren trusted him. That's what comes from knowing who you are and standing by it.
lines.style: Final reflection, calm and assured. A quiet closing statement with the weight of many years behind it. Measured, clear voice. Slight upward lift at the very end — gentle affirmation, not question.
